q: The Gaussian multiple access channel with K users, each with power P, has a sum-rate capacity of:
opts: K · C₁ where C₁ is the single-user capacity
exp: MAC sum-rate capacity: C_sum = ½ log(1 + KP/N). All K users share the channel coherently (superimposed signals), so the total power is KP relative to noise N. This can exceed K times the single-user capacity ½ log(1+P/N) achieved by TDMA.
